errors.rationale: English places freedom from want/perplexity before meditation; Pali puts meditation on 3 and freedom on 4. Group 3/4 at earliest key 3.
Fruitlessness is the aphala predicate on Pali 4, not the well-spoken-word subject on 3. Move predicate plus condition to 4.
Stumbling renders khalitva on 1.2 along with regaining stance; current 1.1 places the stumbling under the thoroughbred comparison.
The whole second-stanza sentence reorders remember-me and Buddha-child terms across Pali 2.1-2.4. Preserve English order as one group on earliest key 2.1 rather than retain misleading fine cuts.
English reverses the meditation/suffusion predicate and rapture/pleasure body phrase across Pali 6.1/6.2. Group the sentence at 6.1.
Returning from alms, approaching the Buddha, bowing and sitting render Pali 3.2. Current 3.1 wrongly includes those whole sentences after going for alms.
English 1.7 continues only the brahman wealth/death clause begun on 1.6. Pali 1.7 is the separate householder clause, which this translation omits. Keep the whole brahman clause on 1.6.
The fourth-truth item follows ellipses in English and renders the explicit path-truth clause opening Pali 3.2; currently it is prematurely on 3.1.
